blocks.vo_line: Meet Neper, the first general purpose language optimised end to end for software generated by language models.
We have turned a tiny program into a native binary in 34 milliseconds, 6,144 bytes.
Its compiler targets more than 1 million lines per second per core, then removes every unreachable byte.
Write one typed kernel, debug it on the CPU, then launch it through Vulkan or CUDA.
Neper ships 7,963 functions, 1,232 algorithms and 112 native UI controls.
Neper is MIT open source, multi platform, and 100% written in Neper itself, from prompt to proof.
